clubs.name: Wrexham A.F.C.
clubs.note: THE MONACO SHAPE, AND ONE CAPACITY. Apart from the capacity this row alters nothing, and records why nothing else was altered: Wrexham is a Welsh club, its ground is in Wales, and it is in GB.json because it plays in the English pyramid - the complete 2026-27 EFL Championship article lists it. The file is England's league pyramid, not England's territory, so do not move it, remove it, or give it a file of its own. Unlike Monaco and Vaduz the country check does NOT flag it: Wikidata's P17 on Q18529 says Q145 United Kingdom and Q25 Wales, and the GB check accepts United Kingdom, so this row is here to say the thing the flag would have said. StadiumDB files its ground under Wales, not England, so crosscheck_stadiumdb.py reads the Wales page for GB as well. Written 2026-09-30. CONTESTED CAPACITY, SETTLED. In use: 10771 (the 2026-27 Championship stadiums table and StadiumDB's Wales page, identical; StadiumDB calls the ground the STōK Cae Ras). Not taken: 13341 (Wikidata, which the map held until now). The UTA Arad rule. Written 2026-09-30.

clubs.name: Brentford F.C.
clubs.note: WRONG GROUND, CORRECTED. Wikidata's only P115 on Q19571 is Q1546623 Griffin Park, which the club left in 2020 (its infobox: closed August 2020, demolished 2021), so the map drew Brentford at a ground that no longer exists - and OpenStreetMap's capacity check found no stadium within 500 m of that pin. The club has played at the Gtech Community Stadium (Brentford Community Stadium, Q4961609, opened 1 September 2020) since: the 2026-27 Premier League stadiums table, StadiumDB, the club's English infobox and the stadium's own infobox all say so. Position: Q4961609's own P625. Capacity in use: 17250 (the table, StadiumDB, both infoboxes). Not taken: 20000 (P1083 on Q4961609); 14863 (Griffin Park's, which the map held until now). Written 2026-09-30.
